interest: Index naming Japan's Bern attaché as Europe's espionage chief.
overview: Cross-reference sheet (1942) naming Japan's Military Attaché in Bern as head of a European espionage network, linked to North Africa.

subfiles.about: A State Department cross-reference sheet recording that the Japanese Military Attaché in Bern directed Japanese espionage operations in Europe.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference note (Jan 1942): Japan's Military Attaché in Bern directed a European espionage network, also noted in North Africa.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet on Japanese Intelligence Service in Europe
